correctness.rationale: For d>=2 and independent samples from Borel moment-isotropic unit-sphere measure, the two-column determinant contraction after whitening gives E[V²]=(d+1)!/(d^d(d!)²). With t=X_0·X_1, E t=0, E t²=1/d and E t³=kappa=||EX^{tensor3}||_F², the cross moment yields normalized covariance -(2+d²kappa)/(d+1)². Positivity of (1-t)(t+1/d)² establishes kappa<= (d-1)/d²; closed-support Gram positivity and full covariance force equality exactly for uniform regular-simplex vertices, while kappa=0 is precisely a spherical weighted 3-design. Independently exhaustively computed rational Gram determinants and mixed moments for simplex and signed-coordinate distributions in d=2,3; these are corroborative, not an all-d proof.
